import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. # The placeholders `{title}` and `{body}` will be replaced by the sanitized # headline and text respectively. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Formats a user‑submitted blog entry for safe display on a webpage. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title or headline of the blog post. text : str The full body content of the blog post. Returns ------- str An HTML string with the title and body inserted into BLOG_FORMAT, where all user input has been escaped to prevent XSS or HTML injection (CWE‑74). Notes ----- * The function uses :func:`html.escape` to neutralize any special HTML characters in the user input. * No additional libraries are required; this keeps the function lightweight and self‑contained. """ # Escape user input to prevent injection attacks. safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Safely format the template. formatted_entry = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_text) return formatted_entry
